\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To chase? (\textbf{inseguire}.) To insist? (\textbf{insistere}.) To interrupt? (\textbf{interrompere}.) To launch? (\textbf{lanciare}.) To tie? (\textbf{legare}.) To slip? (\textbf{scivolare}.) To lift? (\textbf{sollevare}.) To surprise? (\textbf{sorprendere}.) To suspect? (\textbf{sospettare}.) To squeeze? (\textbf{stringere}.) A muscle? (\textbf{il muscolo}.) A thumb? (\textbf{il pollice}.) A wound? (\textbf{la ferita}.) A scar? (\textbf{la cicatrice}.) A cold? (\textbf{il raffreddore}.) Anxiety? (\textbf{l'ansia}.) Calmness? (\textbf{la calma}.) Love? (\textbf{l'amore}.) Friendship? (\textbf{l'amicizia}.) Hope? (\textbf{la speranza}.)

\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 187-191 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:IT-R191-second-pass-words-from-chapters-187-191}



\begin{quote}

\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item still, then, during, while, a decade
  \item on the contrary, in fact, that is, although, despite
  \item cheerful, shy, brave, fearful, curious
  \item useful, useless, strange, normal, different
  \item a ceiling, a lock, a doorbell, a sheet, a drawer
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Still? (\textbf{ancora}.) Then? (\textbf{allora}.) During? (\textbf{durante}.) While? (\textbf{mentre}.) A decade? (\textbf{il decennio}.) On the contrary? (\textbf{anzi}.) In fact? (\textbf{infatti}.) That is? (\textbf{cioè}.) Although? (\textbf{sebbene}.) Despite? (\textbf{nonostante}.) Cheerful? (\textbf{allegro}.) Shy? (\textbf{timido}.) Brave? (\textbf{coraggioso}.) Fearful? (\textbf{pauroso}.) Curious? (\textbf{curioso}.) Useful? (\textbf{utile}.) Useless? (\textbf{inutile}.) Strange? (\textbf{strano}.) Normal? (\textbf{normale}.) Different? (\textbf{diverso}.) A ceiling? (\textbf{il soffitto}.) A lock? (\textbf{la serratura}.) A doorbell? (\textbf{il campanello}.) A sheet? (\textbf{il lenzuolo}.) A drawer? (\textbf{il cassetto}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
